records.title: Hand-Written PTX Tensor-Core GEMM Kernels: A Multi-Precision Study on NVIDIA L4
records.reason: 本文確認後も対象scopeへの適合が間接的/限定的、または推論時の実効効率を評価から確定できないためborderlineとする。

records.title: Multimodal Item Parameter Estimation using Simulated Response Probabilitie
records.reason: This work fine-tunes a multimodal model to reproduce response probabilities for educational measurement; its contribution is prediction accuracy, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability
records.reason: Intrinsic Structure studies identifiability in mechanistic interpretability and does not target runtime inference cost.

records.title: A Convolutional Layer Activation Dimensionality Reduction for Out-of-Distribution and Adversarial Attack Detection Methods
records.reason: The paper reduces convolutional activation dimensionality for OOD/adversarial detection; it is a CNN detection method rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Decodable But Not Detachable: Training Data Granularity Determines Parametric Modularity in Large Language Models
records.reason: Decodable But Not Detachable studies parametric modularity and causal neuron removal in LLMs, but its contribution is interpretability/analysis, not an evaluated inference-efficiency technique.
